facts.fact: For ordinary Lower and Upper Belvedere admissions, the visitor selects an entry time slot; the duration of the visit is not capped by the slot. Combination tickets use the Upper Belvedere slot, with other venues visited the same day around it. Exceptions for named passes exist.
The FAQ states the last admission is 30 minutes before closing and does not allow luggage storage. Slots may still involve some entry waiting.
facts.location: General Questions and time-slot entry answers.

notes: Actual FAQ read; no reservation made, price promise or pass exception inferred for every visitor.
